methodology_caveat: IMPORTANT LIMITATION: this blind pass was performed by the same model that generated the eval queries (Template 4) and ticket seeds (Template 2), in the same conversation. True independence (a separate model/context with no memory of construction intent) is NOT achieved here -- I re-read only the email text and each customer's anonymized OPEN-ticket candidate summaries for each judgment, deliberately not consulting the 'constructed_*' fields until after forming a judgment, but I cannot fully rule out latent bias from having authored both sides. This is a real gap between this pilot and the design's intent (Phase 6's automated pipeline should use an actual separate API call for Template 5, not the same session/model state). Treat the agreement rate below as encouraging but not as strong evidence as a genuinely independent pass would provide.
refinement_iteration: q_15/q_16/q_17 (boilerplate) were re-judged after their email_text was revised -- the first-pass judgment (recorded, then superseded) found all three genuinely unresolvable from text alone across multiple open tickets; see pilot/qa_report.md for the full before/after finding. Original agreement was 17/20 (85%); after the fix, 20/20 (100%).
